label: Keyspace (Sync Gateway REST API addressing)
type: the dot-separated addressing string ({db}, {db}.{collection}, or {db}.{scope}.{collection}) used by every Document and Document-Attachment endpoint on Sync Gateway's REST APIs. Filed as isVariantOf server:keyspace (SQL++'s own bucket.scope.collection addressable unit) - a genuine naming/shape parallel the docs state directly, not a merge: Sync Gateway's keyspace is a URL-path syntax over a database/scope/collection, not literally the same SQL++ construct.
evidence: A keyspace is a dot-separated string, comprised of a database name, and optionally a named scope and collection.
note: Independently minted, identically defined, by two parallel round-28 batches reading the Public and Admin REST API references (rest_api_public.json, rest_api_admin.json) - genuine convergence on one spelling for one concept, not a self-fork. rest_api_admin.json also filed the isVariantOf relation to server:keyspace on this exact evidence.
